description:
This protocol automates RNA extraction according to the 3D Black Bio RNA Extraction Kit.

Using the P300 Multi-Channel Pipette, this protocol can accommodate up to 96 samples per run and can be configured to run any multiple of 8 up to 96. Starting with at least 200µL of sample in a standard 96-well plate, the entire process is automated and ends with 60µL of elution containing RNA dispensed into a 96-well PCR plate. The elution is then ready for RT/qPCR, Next-Gen Sequencing, hybridization, etc.



To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our online store or contact our sales team at info@opentrons.com

Opentrons OT-2
Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 4.0.0 or later)
Opentrons Magnetic Module, GEN2
Opentrons P300 Multi-Channel Pipette
Opentrons 200µL Filter Tips (recommended) or Opentrons 300µL Tips
NEST 96-Deep Well Plate, 2mL
NEST 96-Well PCR Plate
NEST 12-Well Reservoir
NEST 1-Well Reservoir
Opentrons 96-Well Aluminum Block
PCR Tubes
3D Black Bio Extraction Kit
Samples



Reagent Preparation
Prepare all reagents according to manual.

Proteinase K: At least 10µL (12µL is recommended) per column of samples should fill a PCR Strip.
The PCR strip should be placed in column 1 of the Opentrons 96-Well Aluminum Block

MagBeads: At least 20µL (22µL is recommended) per column of samples should fill 1 (or 2, if processing more than 48 samples) PCR strip(s).
The PCR strip(s) should be placed in column(s) 3 (and 4, if processing more than 48 samples) of the Opentrons 96-Well Aluminum Block

Lysis-Binding Mix: In slots 1-6 of the NEST 12-Well Reservoir.
For every column (8 samples), 7mL of Lysis-Binding Mix should be added to the reservoir. Each slot of the 12 well reservoir can accommodate volume for 2 columns/16 samples and should be loaded sequentially (ex. if running 24 samples, slot 1 would get 14mL lysis-binding mix, slot 2 would get 7mL lysis-binding mix, slot 3 would be empty, etc).

Wash 1: In slots 7-12 of the NEST 12-Well Reservoir.
For every column (8 samples), 6.5mL of wash 1 should be added to the reservoir. Each slot of the 12 well reservoir can accommodate volume for 2 columns/16 samples and should be loaded sequentially (ex. if running 24 samples, slot 7 would get 13mL wash 1, slot 8 would get 6.5mL wash 1, slot 9 would be empty, etc).

Wash 2: In NEST 1-Well Reservoir.
For every column (8 samples), 14mL of wash 2 should be added to the reservoir.

Elution Buffer: At least 60µL (65µL is recommended) per column of samples should fill a PCR Strip. Each PCR strip can accommodate up to two columns worth (16) samples.
The PCR strips should be loaded in columns 7-12 of the Opentrons 96-Well Aluminum Block


Deck Layout

Slot 1: NEST 96-Well PCR Plate, containing samples
Slot 2: NEST 1-Well Reservoir containing Wash 2
Slot 3: Opentrons 200µL Filter Tips
Slot 4: Opentrons 96-Well Aluminum Block containing Proteinase K, Magnetic Beads, and Elution Buffer
Slot 5: NEST 12-Well Reservoir containing Lysis-Binding Mix and Wash 1
Slot 6: Opentrons 200µL Filter Tips
Slot 7: Opentrons Magnetic Module, GEN2 with NEST 96-Deep Well Plate, 2mL
Slot 8: Opentrons 200µL Filter Tips
Slot 9: Opentrons 200µL Filter Tips
Slot 10: NEST 1-Well Reservoir, empty for liquid waste
Slot 11: NEST 1-Well Reservoir, empty for liquid waste

Note about tips: The tips in slot 8 will be used for removing supernatant and used tips will be returned to empty tip racks to prevent overflow of the waste bin.

Using the customizations field (below), set up your protocol.
 P300-Multi Mount: Select which mount the P300-Multi is attached to
 Number of Samples: Specify the number of samples to run
